title: ID0469604-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/S3300000004056] No outlets visible on HMI
description:
Reported behavior/Issue: No outlets visible on HMI and SCB offline
Solution: Possibly flash the CFAST card

additional_info.subject: Description
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Although the station is energized, charging cannot be initiated.
The grid voltage levels have been checked, and no abnormalities were observed on the infrastructure side.
CPID : 300000004056
We kindly request your support regarding this issue.
Best regards,
Şahin
software version
: v7.0.5-0-gd66ba3a

additional_info.subject: Important Note
additional_info.body:
I was unable to add the product under main asset; however, the serial number already exists on SCB and ISP tool.
I had a discussion with the Guilherme Andre, and he suggested to try with any other wrong serial number to trigger the SLA and.
SLA got triggered with wrong serial number, hence did a format and forwarded the case in further queue and informed to Guilherme Andre.

additional_info.subject: ID0469604-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/S3300000004056] No outlets visible on HMI CRM:00315003111
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0469604
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: Borusan Enbw
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Charger ID / Serial No.:
xezoOU
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
High
Handover reason: Possibly CFAST corrupted, no outlets on HMI and SCB offline, please take a spare CFAST and the FW version with you. I am sending config files in attachment. You can flash with v7.0.5 even with v6.0.3 config files, and please update to v8.1.4 as soon as possible so that the corruption doesn't happen again.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
